title: Crude Oil Metal (Ni, V) Content vs. Gravity
description: Content of nickel and vanadium in more than 120 crudes as function of specific gravity@15°C/60°F. This tool is based on information from more than 120 crude oil assays from BP, ExxonMobile and Statoil (2008 - 2017). The crudes are produced all over the world. Each datapoint represents one specific oil.
